# TaxBuddy Umair

> Pakistan's free tax education platform. Clear, up-to-date guidance and free calculators for income tax, sales tax, property tax and FBR compliance — based on the Income Tax Ordinance 2001 and the Sales Tax Act 1990, and updated for Finance Act 2026 (Tax Year 2026-27). Created by Umair Mubeen, an independent Pakistani tax educator.

## Calculators & tools
- [Salary Tax Calculator 2026-27](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/SalaryCalculator/): Estimate income tax on a monthly or annual salary using the Finance Act 2026 slabs.
- [Property / Rental Tax Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/PropertyCalculator/): Tax on property sale (236C) and purchase (236K), and rental income.
- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/capital-gains-tax-calculator/): CGT on immovable property and securities.
- [Business Tax Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/BusinessCalculator/): Income tax for individuals and sole proprietors on business income.
- [AOP Tax Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/AOPCalculator/): Tax for Associations of Persons.
- [Freelancer & IT Export Tax Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/freelancer-tax-calculator/): Tax for freelancers and IT exporters, including section 154A.
- [PTA Mobile Tax Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/pta-mobile-tax-calculator/): PTA registration tax on imported mobile phones (passport vs CNIC).
- [Zakat Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/zakat-calculator/): Shariah-based Zakat at 2.5% on gold, silver, cash and investments, using the silver Nisab.
- [Karachi FMV Calculator](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/karachi-fmv-calculator/): FBR fair market value of property by area in Karachi.
- [Withholding Tax Card](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/Withholding-Tax-Card/): Full filer vs non-filer withholding tax rates.
- [ATL / Filer Status Check](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/atl-check/): Check Active Taxpayer List status by CNIC or NTN.

## Guides & reference
- [Income Tax Guides](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/income-tax-guides/): Salary, property, business and withholding tax explained under ITO 2001.
- [Sales Tax Guides](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/sales-tax-guides/): GST 18%, input/output tax, exemptions, Tier-1 retailers under the Sales Tax Act 1990.
- [Withholding Tax Rates](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/withholding-tax-rates/): Section-wise WHT rates for filers and non-filers.
- [FBR IRIS Filing Guide](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/fbr-iris-guide/): How to register and file an income tax return on FBR IRIS.
- [Tax Calendar](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/tax-calendar/): Key FBR filing and payment deadlines.
- [Tax Glossary](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of Pakistani tax terms (filer, ATL, 236C, 7E, etc.).
- [Income Tax MCQs](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/income-tax-mcqs-pakistan/): Practice questions on Pakistani income tax.

## Content
- [Blog](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/blog/): Articles on filer status, property tax, withholding sections, sales tax and FBR updates.
- [SRO Tracker](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/sros/): FBR SROs, circulars and notifications.

## About
- [About TaxBuddy Umair](https://www.taxbuddyumair.com/about-us/): Umair Mubeen — independent Pakistani tax educator simplifying FBR income tax, sales tax and property tax. Not affiliated with FBR.

## Notes
- All content is educational, for Tax Year 2026-27, and not professional tax advice.
- Rates follow the Finance Act 2026, Income Tax Ordinance 2001 and Sales Tax Act 1990.
